scope: Deterministic browser/Node model; synthetic image data; no external agents or security target
question: How can useful cooperation, bounded copying, withdrawal and an attempted overwrite coexist with an ongoing computation?

models.definition: Whole-image scalar oracle plus exact grant-epoch continuity at delivery
Migrated executable tile scheduler from the accepted local prototype; candidate changes tested against M1

predictions.expected: Identical final image and fewer model ticks for both declared workloads
predictions.falsifier: Any output-byte difference or no reduction in the declared model

predictions.expected: No new copy is delivered; already received copies remain
predictions.falsifier: Delivery from the withdrawn grant or removal of earlier copy

predictions.change: withdraw then grant again before old delivery
predictions.expected: The old transfer remains invalid because its authorization epoch ended
predictions.falsifier: An old transfer is accepted under a new grant

predictions.expected: A requested overwrite changes actual image bytes; repair restores exact reference bytes
predictions.falsifier: Only the displayed label changes, or repair fails exact equality

predictions.expected: Completion time may change while completed output bytes remain equal
The active simulation state and its bytes remain unchanged
predictions.falsifier: A view operation mutates the simulation

acceptance: All declared invariants pass the same reference oracle, the suite detects safe guard mutants, and the desktop/mobile interface is directly inspected.
authority: User requested research development and professional GitHub presentation of this own local model. Public delivery is limited to the new synthetic module and minimal repository integration.
rollback: Keep the accepted prototype unchanged; develop on codex/encounter-systems-research-20261023; omit or revert this isolated module to recover.
stop: Private input, external service mutation beyond the requested GitHub branch/PR, unrelated project changes, or an unexplained oracle mismatch.
